excerpts.title: Awake, eyes closed, before sleep: alpha rhythm (8 to 12 Hz), no stimulation yet
N2 sleep: sleep spindles (11 to 16 Hz bursts) and K-complexes
Deep sleep: large slow waves, and the sounds the Portiloop sent on their up-states
REM sleep (automatic staging): rapid eye movements on the EOG channels, low chin EMG
A movement during sleep: large deflections on several channels; epochs like these are rejected
Near the end of the night a movement disturbs every channel and the Cz electrode comes off: its raw signal stays at the limit of the amplifier, and the Portiloop stops stimulating
excerpts.note: raw signal minus its median over the previous minute; values beyond +/-3276 uV are clipped
